parties:
SREE SANKAR CHANDRA DAS
vs.
MD. JAHANGIR HOSSAIN AND OTHERS
full_judgment: 3. The contention of the plaint of opposite party Nos. 1 and 2, in short, is that Kartik Chandra Das got 9.59 acres of land which includes the schedule land (5.19 acres of land) in 1360 BS by way of partition. But S.A. record was wrongly prepared in the name of Jitendra Nath, Binoy Bhuson and others whereupon the said Kartik Chandra Das filed Title Suit No. 280 of 1962 before the learned V' Sub-Judge, Barisal and got judgment and decree dated 18.08.1962 (decree signed on 25.08.1962) in his favour. Thereafter Kartik Chandra Das filed Mutation case No. 3880 of 1963 before the Revenue Deputy Collector and got order dated 06.07.1963 in his favour and accordingly the relevant khatian were corrected in his name Kartik Chandra Das had been possessing the schedule land by giving rents to the government. Thereafter Kartik Chandra Das declared to sell the schedule land and the opposite party Nos. 1 and 2 agreed to purchase the same upon consideration of Tk. 4,50,000/-. Accordingly on 13th Falgun 1408 Bs i.e. on 25.02.2002 Kartik Chandra Das took Tk. 4,30,000/- from opposite party Nos. 1 and 2, executed an agreement for sale and also hand over physical possession of the schedule land in favour of opposite party Nos. 1 and 2. According to the terms and conditions of the said agreement for sale Kartik Chandra Das would execute Saf-kanala deed in favour of opposite party Nos. 1 and 2 after collecting the necessary papers and receiving the rest Tk. 20,000/-. The opposite party Nos. 1 and 2 several times requested Kartik Chandra Das to take rest Tk. 20,000/- and execute saf-kabala deed in their favour but he failed to do so. Thereafter Kartik Chandra Das died in the month of Bhadra of 1411 BS leaving behind the petitioner and opposite party No. 3. The opposite party Nos. 1 and 2 also requested the petitioner and opposite party No. 3 to execute saf-kabala deed in their favour but on 8th Falgun 1411 i.e. 20.02.2005 the petitioner and opposite party No. 3 denie3d to execute sal-kabala deed in their favour for which the opposite party Nos. 1 and 2 as plaintiff filed Title Suit No. 2 of 2005.
